# socratink-app

> Learner-led knowledge mapping app. Generation over recognition. The graph reflects learner-generated evidence Socratink has recorded, not what the learner has read. Chat is ignition, not the product surface.

## Canon
- [README.md](/README.md): repo shape, runtime surfaces, local run/test commands
- [DESIGN.md](/DESIGN.md): product intent, decisions, design primitives, voice, boundaries (~160 lines)
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): agent ops — commands, conventions, git workflow
- [UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md](/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md): canonical domain terms + aliases to avoid
- [Project state](/docs/project/state.md): current release posture, persistence truth, active risks
